event.title: Republicans Launch First-Ever Midterm Convention in Dallas
event.canonical_title: Republicans Launch First-Ever Midterm Convention in Dallas
event.summary: Trump and JD Vance are set to headline a two-day Republican convention in Dallas ahead of the November midterm elections. The event aims to energize the party's base and increase voter turnout, as midterms typically pose challenges for the party in power. Trump's focus on the convention reflects his influence within the Republican Party.

timeline.title: Republicans Launch First-Ever Midterm Convention in Dallas
timeline.summary: The 2026 Republican Midterm Convention has commenced in Dallas, Texas, featuring a keynote speech by Donald Trump. This unprecedented event, dubbed a 'Trumpapalooza,' marks the first time Republicans have held a midterm convention.
key_facts: Event taking place in Dallas, Texas
